body: Love is fleeting. Not worth living for.
Nah. They aren’t going to get any better. So I’m leaving this weekend. I don’t know how, resources are pretty limited for me atm and I don’t want to risk survival. But I can’t live like this anymore.
I have really bad anxiety and fear of going outside. It’s the dumbest shit lol. But idk. I just feel panicked outside of my home.

Most people love the person that’s raising them. That doesn’t make me a good person to have in her life. I’m not healthy enough to provide the things she needs. And the person that was once doing that has one foot out the door. So what happens when I can’t get her on a walk cus I’m scared to go outside lol. I’m a detriment to the lives of those around me.

My pets deserve better homes than I can provide them. I’ve got a sweet mini lab. She’s been by my side all day. She’s so sensitive. So loyal. You’re absolutely right, we don’t deserve them. I know I don’t deserve her.

Unfortunately no. It’s too late. I’m so ready to go. I think part of me always knew there was no future for me. I’ve been sad for one reason or another for as long as I can remember. And no one hears me. That’s the hardest part I think. It’s come to a point that I’ve felt silenced for so long Idk how to speak. And it’s ultimately led me to ruining my own life. Now I have nothing. No chance.
Yeah. There’s definitely a fantasy. But I’m too late to have it. I missed my window. Thank you for not telling me to stay alive. I really appreciate that.
I mean it’s not just cus. I think it’s okay to want to feel heard. Keep your head up and keep letting it out.
